draft_text: Asterion outperformed RuneSpan on Meridian-QA, while Darsen and Ko reported that Patchwise Replay improves exact-match accuracy on the same benchmark.
revised_text: Asterion achieved higher exact-match accuracy than RuneSpan on Meridian-QA (80.4% vs 78.0%, a mean gain of 2.4 percentage points over 8 seeds), while Darsen and Ko (2023) describe applying Patchwise Replay by revisiting high-loss training passages after each epoch.
rationale: Table T1 supports Asterion's higher mean EM (80.4 vs 78.0, +2.4pp), so "outperformed" is supported as a mean difference. However, P1 only describes applying Patchwise Replay in a preliminary experiment; it does not state that it "improves exact-match accuracy on the same benchmark." No test reported for cmp1, so no significance claim is made (sentence doesn't claim significance).
